title: Correct Daily Radar coupon card source title

acceptance.text: Correct the canonical Daily Radar coupon card seed so Vietnamese title is Vietnamese and Japanese title is populated; apply canonical local seed and verify persisted values through PostgreSQL and the visible localized screen.

spec.expected_behavior: Coupon card title fields match their locale in canonical source and local database.
spec.observed_behavior: The canonical seed stores Japanese text in titleVi and leaves titleJa null; the Vietnamese screen renders Japanese title.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only coupon-terms title fields in the seed data and restore prior local seed row if needed.

red_targets.test: Daily Radar seed localization > stores the coupon card title in the matching Vietnamese and Japanese fields
red_targets.expect: Đọc điều kiện coupon / khuyến mãi

red_targets.test: Daily Radar seed localization > provides structured expressions consumed by the card detail screen
